verdict_scale: clear = explicit CC0/CC BY(-SA) by the person who generated/uploaded the file, or PD tag released by the creator; likely = PD-algorithm (no-human-authorship) tag on a third-party re-host of a developer demo, with developer statement supporting machine-only output, OR clear licence but model claim only partly corroborated; unclear/no = rejected.
global_licence_caveat: Every 'PD-algorithm' basis is a Wikimedia Commons uploader/community assertion (US Copyright Office position that outputs without human authorship are not protected). None of OpenAI, Google DeepMind or Google Research has published a reuse licence for these demo clips. The Commons tag text itself warns: UK and Hong Kong give computer-generated works 50 years of protection, and AI outputs can be derivative of training data. Source labels and credits should still be shown in the film even where not legally required.
